record.paper_title: On three open problems related to quasi relative interior
record.original_question: Let X be a separated locally convex topological vector space. For a subset S of X, let cone(S) denote the conic hull of S and let cl(cone(S)) denote its closure in X. For a nonempty convex set E in X, define the quasi-relative interior qri(E) as the set of points x in E such that cl(cone(E - x)) is a linear subspace of X. Let C and D be nonempty convex subsets of X with qri(C) intersect qri(D) nonempty. Must qri(C intersect D) be contained in qri(C) intersect qri(D), or can this inclusion fail?

evidence.quote: Throughout the paper, if not specified otherwise, X is a separated locally convex space and X ∗ is its topological dual.

Let C ⊂ X be a convex set; the quasi interior of C (see [1, p. 2544]) is the set qi C := {x ∈ C | cone(C − x) = X} , and the quasi relative interior of C (see [2, Def. 2.3]) is the set qri C := {x ∈ C | cone(C − x) is a linear space} ;
Proposition 3 Let C, D ⊂ X be nonempty convex sets.
(ii) If qri C ∩ qri D 6= ∅ then qri(C ∩ D) ⊂ qri C ∩ qri D.
Borwein and Goebel, in [1, p. 2548], also say “Can qri(C ∩ D) ⊂ qri C ∩ qri D fail when qri C ∩ qri D 6= ∅? ”
Proposition 3 (ii) shows that the answer to this question is negative.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a separated locally convex topological vector space. For a subset $S\subseteq X$, let $\operatorname{cone}(S)=\{\lambda s : \lambda\ge 0,\ s\in S\}$ denote the conic hull of $S$, and let $\overline{\operatorname{cone}}(S)$ denote its closure in $X$. For a nonempty convex set $E\subseteq X$, define the quasi-relative interior of $E$ by
$$\operatorname{qri}(E) := \{x\in E : \overline{\operatorname{cone}}(E-x) \text{ is a linear subspace of } X\}.$$
Let $C,D\subseteq X$ be nonempty convex subsets such that $\operatorname{qri}(C)\cap\operatorname{qri}(D)\neq\emptyset$. Determine whether the inclusion
$$\operatorname{qri}(C\cap D) \subseteq \operatorname{qri}(C)\cap\operatorname{qri}(D)$$
holds in general, or provide a counterexample.
artifact.status_search_result: The result is established as Proposition 3(ii) in the work treating this question: under the hypothesis $\operatorname{qri}(C)\cap\operatorname{qri}(D)\neq\emptyset$, the inclusion $\operatorname{qri}(C\cap D)\subseteq\operatorname{qri}(C)\cap\operatorname{qri}(D)$ holds.

status_evidence.title: On three open problems related to quasi relative interior
status_evidence.snippet: If qri C ∩ qri D ≠ ∅ then qri(C ∩ D) ⊂ qri C ∩ qri D.
status_evidence.claim: The inclusion holds and is proved as Proposition 3(ii).
